# Get Your Annie’s Blue Ribbon Order with Same Day Delivery


We’re thrilled to announce our partnership with Annie’s Blue Ribbon to offer same-day delivery for their customers in Brooklyn, Manhattan and Queens! With the[Getcho Shopify App](https://apps.shopify.com/same-day-delivery-by-getcho) integrated directly into the Annie’s Blue Ribbon website, users can now shop online and select same-day delivery with ease. Enjoy a fast and reliable service that brings your favorite items from Annie’s Blue Ribbon straight to your door.


## How to Order from Annie’s Blue Ribbon for Same Day Delivery


Ordering from nie’s Blue Ribbon for same day delivery is straightforward. After adding items to your cart, proceed to checkout, enter your zip code, and if you’re in an eligible area in New York, the “Same Day Delivery” option will appear.


### Steps to Get Same Day Delivery with Getcho


1.


**Visit Annie’s Blue Ribbon Website**
Browse the Annie’s Blue Ribbon website and add your desired items to your cart.


2.


**Proceed to Checkout**
Once you’ve finalized your selection, go to checkout.


3.


**Enter Your Zip Code**
Type in your zip code to check if same-day delivery is available in your area. If eligible, the **Local Delivery** option will appear in the shipping methods.


4.


**Choose Local Delivery**
Select **Local Delivery** for same-day service. Orders placed by 4 pm will arrive the same day. Orders after 4 pm will be delivered the next day.


1.


**Delivery Details**
Enter your mobile number and any specific delivery instructions to assist the courier.


2.


**Complete Your Order**
Confirm your payment and order details. Same-day delivery has a **flat fee of $9.50** .


## Why Choose Getcho for Annie’s Blue Ribbon Delivery?


With Getcho’s integration directly into the Annie’s Blue Ribbon Shopify platform, customers in most of Brooklyn, all of Manhattan, and parts of Queens can enjoy the convenience of same-day delivery. Here’s what you can expect:


1. **Speed** – Your order will arrive within hours, making last-minute shopping easy.
2. **Convenience** – Shop online and have your items delivered right to your door.
3. **Reliability** – Experienced couriers ensure your delivery is smooth and on time.
4. **Real-Time Tracking** – Stay informed with tracking and notifications throughout the delivery.


This streamlined process ensures you receive your Annie’s Blue Ribbon items quickly and conveniently. Perfect for city residents who value efficiency, Getcho brings your purchases directly to your doorstep.
